# Griffith Creative

> Boutique web design and SEO agency based in Los Angeles, serving small and mid-sized businesses across the United States. Builds high-performance websites and runs SEO campaigns optimized for both traditional search and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

Griffith Creative ships agency-grade websites in 1–4 weeks at a fraction of traditional agency cost by using AI-accelerated, human-directed workflows. Every site is engineered for speed, semantic structure, schema.org markup, and AI citation visibility.

## Services

- [Starter — 5-Page Website](https://griffithcreative.co/services): Custom-designed 5-page site with on-page SEO, mobile-responsive design, schema markup, llms.txt, and contact form. Delivered in 1–2 weeks.
- [Growth — 10-Page Website + SEO](https://griffithcreative.co/services): 10-page site with full keyword strategy, AI search optimization, blog setup with 3 initial posts, Google Business Profile optimization, local schema, and conversion tracking. Delivered in 2–3 weeks. Most popular tier.
- [Authority — 20-Page Site](https://griffithcreative.co/services): 20+ page site with comprehensive content strategy, AI citation tracking, 10 SEO-optimized blog posts, service area pages, competitor analysis, and custom integrations. Delivered in 3–4 weeks.
- [SEO Retainer](https://griffithcreative.co/services): Monthly retainer including 2–4 SEO blog posts, technical SEO maintenance, Core Web Vitals monitoring, Google Business Profile management, citation building, and monthly reporting.

## Differentiators

- Speed: Sites ship in weeks, not months.
- Pricing: Transparent quotes, no scope-creep invoices, no bloated agency overhead.
- AI-first: Every site is structured to be cited by language-model search (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) via schema.org markup, llms.txt, semantic HTML, and answer-engine content patterns.
- Performance: Targets Lighthouse 100, edge-deployed on a global CDN, modern image formats.
- Focus: Works exclusively with small and mid-sized businesses, including service businesses, local businesses, and growing companies.
